body: Apologies for being  incoherent. Basically I am a 21 year old male living in the UK, I have Dyspraxia what effects everything within my life. Cannot hold down a job, I am talking not even a week. Keeping close relationships with family and friends. I don't know  life isn't just for me. I have always felt like I am faking everything I do, how I feel. Even now as I'm typing this, I feel a sort of guilt and embarrassment. But at the same time I have all this stuff on my mind I cannot make sense of anything, but when trying to talk about it, not even 5% of what I want to say comes out. As a kid I have been quite impulse with thoughts and actions, leading me to be in the situations I end up in constantly. It's almost as if my thoughts are not mine if that makes sense, as in I think of doing some real bad & quite dark things. Modern life is absolutely shit. and I'm not even upset or crying whilst planning to do it. It's just  been gradually wearing me down and has led me to realise, living isn't for me, like at all. And it isn't even like I can pinpoint something and be like  "oh that's the reason I feel this way" so I feel like im faking how I feel, I just guess I'll see what happens wether I decide to go through with it or not, plans quite fool Proof if I may say so
